The Ramsey number R(4, 3) is 9, which means such a graph exists for 8 vertices. A well-known extremal graph for this is the Wagner graph (or the circular graph C_8(1, 4)), where each vertex i is connected to (i+1), (i-1), and (i+4) modulo 8. This graph is 3-regular, triangle-free, and its maximum independent set has size 3. By assigning blue (1) to the edges of this graph and red (0) to its non-edges, we satisfy both conditions.
